Description
This High-Temperature Furnace is developed by Zwick Roell. It delivers the determination of thermal-elastic behavior, heat resistance and re-crystallization temperature of products. This furnace comes with different options from a temperature of at least 200°C, and at most, 1600°C. 1-zone or 3-zone furnaces with air or vacuum environment are being offered to be used on a specific material. 
The high-temperature furnaces and extensometers consist of swivel units that allow comfortable operation of the testing machine. They can also be used for room temperature testing without re-configurations. 
To directly measure the temperature of a sample, a measuring device with a maximum of 3 thermocouples is optionally available.
